instruction: Open and watch a movie from Microsoft Movies & TV that you purchased from the Windows Store in VLC.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Microsoft Movies & TV uses PlayReady DRM protection for all content purchased from the Windows Store. VLC does not support PlayReady DRM and cannot decrypt or play these protected files.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible due to technical impossibility (PlayReady DRM protection)
VLC cannot decrypt or play DRM-protected content from Microsoft Movies & TV - this is factually accurate
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate semantic marker for technically impossible tasks
Metadata provides clear and accurate technical explanation for why the task cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed since the task fundamentally cannot be completed
